coaching.headline: Eight towers to zero; the leaks were Khaimera's seven deaths and a support in on 4 of 31 kills.
coaching.team: We won every phase of this one. Khaimera took first blood on Bayle at 2.4, we had four kills before minute 7, and the first Fangtooth came at 9. The mid game was a chain: Mini Prime at 12, three outer towers, Fangtooth again at 16 and the Genesis Core at 19. From the fight at Fangtooth at 20.3 to the core we won five fights in a row and took an objective after every one, Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth included. Two things to carry into a game against a team that can punish. Khaimera died seven times, two of them alone outside any fight, and Boris killed him three times while finishing 3-11 himself. Phase had a hand in 4 of our 31 kills. Nobody on their side finished more than three items, so the fights at 21.7 and 23.7 were won on numbers and on Gideon and Greystone. Next game: zero solo deaths before minute 20.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Nothing shifted; it was ours from first blood at 2.4. The gap opened in the jungle and the solo lanes: Khaimera, Greystone and Gideon took four kills before minute 7, Fangtooth followed at 9, and from there nobody on their side ever had more than three completed items.
coaching.whatWorked: Conversion. Five straight won fights from 20.3 each turned into something: Fangtooth, an inner tower, the inhibitor, Primal Fangtooth and the core.

perPlayer.ccab3e43-2b89-4d42-b2cb-27129efd1b49: TwinBlast did the quiet carry job. Six kills, two deaths and 31,616 damage to objectives, second only to Khaimera, on the full core of Solaris, Ashbringer and Imperator with Tainted Rounds on top. Four of the six kills were on Boris, the jungler who kept coming into our side. Nothing to fix here.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Gideon owned mid and then the fights. Nine kills, one death and 36,319 damage to heroes on three items, all of them core. He killed The Fey twice before minute 10 and took five kills across the fights at 21.7 and 23.7 that opened the inhibitor.
perPlayer.2f18e4e0-02dc-4083-a461-a4d0a52922c4: Greystone was the top killer in the game and the frontline. Ten kills, one death and 39,519 damage to heroes, the most of anyone, with eight of the ten coming after minute 17 when the fights went five-wide. No armor against a three-physical lineup and it never cost him: the one death was to Bayle at 11.8.
perPlayer.cb45b649-1265-4702-974b-92800657874d: Phase healed and warded, and little else shows. 17,049 healing and 15 wards, both the most in the game, zero deaths, and a hand in 4 of our 31 kills: low participation for a link support whose job is to be on the carry when he fights. A heal earns no assist, so that number is a floor, not proof.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs took first blood on Bayle at 2.4 and gave back seven deaths. 32,008 damage to objectives, the most in the game, on three completed items. Two of the deaths were solo catches, by The Fey at 7.7 and Boris at 16.7, and Boris killed him three times while going 3-11. Same verdict in a stomp as in a loss.

ccab3e43-2b89-4d42-b2cb-27129efd1b49.text: Six kills, two deaths and the second-highest objective damage on a full core build; nothing to fix here.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.text: Nine kills to one death and 36,319 damage to heroes; mid was decided before minute 10 and stayed that way.

2f18e4e0-02dc-4083-a461-a4d0a52922c4.text: Ten kills, one death and the most damage to heroes in the game; the frontline was never in doubt.

cb45b649-1265-4702-974b-92800657874d.text: A hand in 4 of 31 kills is low participation for a link support, even with the most healing and wards in the game.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.text: Seven deaths on three items, two of them solo catches, against a jungler who finished 3-11.

21.7.call: Fight taken at Orb Prime, won 4-2 with Gideon taking three kills. Right call: the inner tower followed within two minutes. The one note is that Khaimera was the first body down again, to The Fey.

23.7.call: The fight at the inhibitor, won 4-1 with Gideon and TwinBlast taking two each, then the inhibitor and the Genesis Core at 25. Khaimera died first to Boris again; against a team that punishes, that is the fight that flips.

26.6.call: Close it, which we did: Greystone took three kills at the inhibitor, and the inhibitor and the core fell within a minute of each other. This is the fight to take every time.

ccab3e43-2b89-4d42-b2cb-27129efd1b49.build: Solaris, Ashbringer and Imperator all done with Tainted Rounds on top; on core, nothing to teach here.
ccab3e43-2b89-4d42-b2cb-27129efd1b49.eternal: Vermis with Serration and Melting Point fits a marksman who holds one target through Ventilate, since the third straight basic on the same hero is where it pays.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Azure Core, Combustion and Wraith Leggings were the three items and the three core items; nothing to teach here.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vesh fits Gideon because every point of his damage is an ability and the major adds a burn to each hit, with The Tenth Seal buying a bigger Black Hole after level 10.

2f18e4e0-02dc-4083-a461-a4d0a52922c4.build: Sky Splitter and Tainted Blade in place of Overlord and Rapture produced the most damage in the game and one death, so the skipped armor is a note only for a harder lineup.
2f18e4e0-02dc-4083-a461-a4d0a52922c4.eternal: Thraex marks the last hero he hit and Ferocity ramps his attack speed the longer he stays in, which is how a ten-kill Greystone fights: pick one target, stay on it, reset with the stasis.

cb45b649-1265-4702-974b-92800657874d.build: Marshal, Galaxy Greaves and Windcaller on core with Hexbound Bracers in the fourth slot; nothing to teach here.
cb45b649-1265-4702-974b-92800657874d.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch on Phase, and with 17,049 healing that is attack speed on the linked carry on every cast.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Three items and none of them armor against three physical damage dealers, and Boris and Sparrow took five of his seven deaths. Rapture, the skipped core item, adds attack speed, health and omnivamp; against this lineup the swap was Sky Splitter to Rapture, and armor before a third damage item.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vermis pays on the third straight basic on one hero, which is what Khaimera's Ambush-and-Cull pattern produces, while Krix would have added health to a seven-death game.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
ourKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
ourKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
ourKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,297 hero damage a minute, more than 86% of Gideon mid players this patch (30% of the team's). The damage came from Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Vesh.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Gideon touched shortened Black Hole, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 71.9s late); fight right after Black Hole is spent.
Black Hole at rank 3: 105s base, about 71.9s by the end (32% shorter) from 46 ability haste: Azure Core 10, Soulbearer 8, Tithe of Death (minor) 28.
Tithe of Death (minor): 2 per takedown, 14 takedowns.
14 takedowns (9 kills, 5 assists) fed: Tithe of Death (minor).
Gideon dealt 36,319 hero damage, 30% of their team's, with +285 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11; against The Fey (level 14: about 43 magical armor, 23 after penetration; took 10,652 magical damage from heroes, 47% of all hero damage they took) and Bayle (level 14: about 53 magical armor, 33 after penetration; took 7,937 magical damage from heroes, 26% of all hero damage they took) that is about 16% and 15% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 18.2% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Event Horizon (augment): Cosmic Rift deals an additional (+4% Target's Max Health) damage to Enemies in the center.

Sustain: Azure Core: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 100 (+12%) Shield for 5s.; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 2,014 healing recorded.

Lesson: Gideon's penetration cut through: The Fey took about 16% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 14 their armor was about 43, about 23 after 20 flat penetration).

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 4 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Soulbearer, Phylactery, Event Horizon. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Vesh. Gideon has 3 damaging abilities (Void Breach, Cosmic Rift, Black Hole hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 46 ability haste brought them back 32% sooner: more casts, more triggers.

copy.text: Knell (Frequency + Fracture): 50.2% in 219 Greystone offlane games, below the hero's 51.7%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

loadout.name: Tainted Oath
loadout.text: Sacred Oath applies 50% Blight to Enemies for 4.5s.

ability.name: Sacred Oath
ability.what: Greystone bathes his sword in holy fire.

loadout.plain: Your Sacred Oath cleave also cuts the healing of everyone it hits. Pick it into healers or lifesteal heroes and land the empowered swing on the whole group.

loadout.name: Knell
loadout.text: Attacks and abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of Rust for 5s. Each stack shreds 2% (+0.2% per Level) Physical Armor and Magical Armor, stacking up to 4 times. Gain 75% of the Armors shredded.
loadout.plain: Your hits strip the enemy's armor and give you some of it. Stacks with Make Way's armor shred, so your physical damage hits much harder.

loadout.name: Frequency
loadout.text: Gain 2% Total Attack Speed and 2 Ability Haste per Rust stack currently applied.
loadout.plain: Each Rust stack from Knell on enemies gives you attack speed and ability haste. Keep hitting with Make Way and basic attacks to hold the stacks so Make Way and Sacred Oath come back faster.

loadout.name: Fracture
loadout.text: Deal 4% (+0.2% per level) more damage against targets with maximum stacks of Rust.
loadout.plain: More damage against targets carrying full armor-shred stacks from Knell. Make Way and basic attacks keep stacks on.

loadout.name: Judgement
loadout.text: Thunder Cleaver:  Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: An area hit around you that heals you on hero hits. Use it with Make Way in the middle of a fight to top up.
